hint.text: Apples, bananas, berries and oranges are fruit.

feedback.end: Fruit is a healthy snack. It may taste sweet or sour.

hint.text: Potatoes, carrots, broccoli and spinach are vegetables.

feedback.end: Vegetables are very healthy. Raw vegetables can taste different from cooked vegetables. Be careful though, as not all vegetables can be eaten raw.

hint.text: Milk, yoghurt, cheese and butter are dairy products.

feedback.end: Dairy products are usually made from cow’s or goat’s milk. Milk can strengthen your bones.

hint.text: Steaks, lamb chops, bacon and chicken are forms of meat.

feedback.end: Meat is the flesh of an animal. Mostly, the meat we eat comes from cows, chickens, sheep and pigs. Meat can help strengthen your muscles.

hint.text: Bread, pasta, rice and porridge are popular forms of grains.

feedback.end: Grains give your body healthy energy. They are often ground into flour. Flour is used to make bread and pasta.
